enemy_target_lock.setting.include_player: Whether other players can be locked onto, not just mobs.
enemy_target_lock.setting.lock_range.too: Only targets within this many blocks can be locked onto or switched to.
enemy_target_lock.setting.pick_cone_degr: A new lock only picks targets within this many degrees of where you look.
enemy_target_lock.setting.lan_friends.to: Let friends who join your world over LAN, and also have this mod, use lock-on there. Turn it off to keep it to yourself: friends with the mod are then disconnected with the reason.
enemy_target_lock.setting.max_lock_dista: The lock is released when the target gets farther than this many blocks away.
enemy_target_lock.setting.max_hidden_sec: The lock is released after the target has been behind blocks this long.
enemy_target_lock.setting.switch_on_deat: When the target dies, lock onto the nearest other one instead of releasing.
enemy_target_lock.setting.aim_height.too: Where on the target to aim: 0 is its feet, 1 the top of its head.
enemy_target_lock.setting.aim_speed.tool: How quickly your real aim (where hits and shots go) turns to the target.
enemy_target_lock.setting.max_turn_degre: The fastest your aim turns, so big swings stay readable.
enemy_target_lock.setting.projectile_aim: Aim bows, crossbows, tridents and thrown items for drop and target movement.
enemy_target_lock.setting.view_speed.too: How quickly the first-person view catches up with your aim. Lower is smoother.
enemy_target_lock.setting.cinematic_came: Use the over-the-shoulder camera when locked in third person (F5).
enemy_target_lock.setting.camera_distanc: How far behind you the third-person camera sits, in blocks.
enemy_target_lock.setting.camera_shoulde: How far to the side: positive is the right shoulder, negative the left.
How far above your eyes the third-person camera sits.
enemy_target_lock.setting.camera_focus.t: Where the camera looks: 0 is you, 1 is the target.
enemy_target_lock.setting.fov_scale.tool: Field of view while locked in third person, as a share of your normal FOV.
enemy_target_lock.setting.camera_positio: How quickly the third-person camera moves into place. Lower is floatier.
enemy_target_lock.setting.camera_angle_s: How quickly the third-person camera turns. Lower is floatier.
enemy_target_lock.setting.lock_dot.toolt: Draw a dot on the locked target.
enemy_target_lock.setting.dot_size.toolt: How big the lock dot is: its radius in GUI pixels.
enemy_target_lock.setting.dot_opacity.to: How see-through the lock dot is: 0 is invisible, 1 is solid.
enemy_target_lock.setting.dot_outline.to: Width of the dark ring around the lock dot, so it shows on bright backgrounds. 0 turns it off.
enemy_target_lock.setting.hide_crosshair: Hide the normal crosshair while a target is locked.
enemy_target_lock.setting.assist_enabled: When not locked, gently nudge your aim toward the mob under the crosshair.
enemy_target_lock.setting.assist_max_ang: Only nudge when the target is within this many degrees of the crosshair.
enemy_target_lock.setting.assist_step_de: The most the assist nudges your aim per tick, in degrees.
